title: The newly wired EGW fallback still needs original-response replay, an independent provider start and exact team identity before it is safe
detail: Read-only recheck on 2026-10-24: main a0c08fa and PR #246 head 67d1356 now load automated EGW entries, so the old missing-loader warning no longer describes them. However, the independent synthetic gate still fails three required checks on PR #246: load_live does not replay original HTML plus its request manifest; a Ground Zero–Off Chops probe is emitted without any provider timestamp; and a Spirit/LFO probe incorrectly matches a Spirit Academy/LFO 10 URL. These are synthetic safety probes, not published picks or probabilities. PR #237 head 5600a3a passes all four required checks. Final integration should preserve that safer implementation and must not call the older derived-only loader verified merely because it is wired. The observed real-markup sibling-price case remains fail-closed with zero entries, so automated real-page capture is not claimed.
